summary: Completed full exploration with all 9 runs. Best result: 0.995888 (embedding_lr 0.8, unembedding_lr 0.006, matrix_lr 0.06) beats baseline 0.996598 by +0.0007. Systematic testing of: learning rate escalation (plateau at 0.8), schedules (neutral), depth changes (worse), width scaling (overfitting), head dimensions (optimal at 128), weight decay variations (0.1-0.15 range near optimal), and scalar_lr tuning (optimum near 0.4, not lower). Failed to reproduce a3's 0.995457 result despite multiple attempts with their reported configurations. Architecture (8 layers, aspect_ratio 64, head_dim 128) well-optimized. Learning rates confirmed as primary lever; further gains require fundamental innovations or precise hyperparameter discovery beyond current search space.
